children: U.S. clean energy equipment maker's Q3 revenue rose 9.6%, beating analyst expectations
Net loss for Q3 narrowed year-over-year to $1.59 mln
Gross margin improved by 7 percentage points on higher services revenue and operational gains
Tecogen says backlog exceeds $8 mln, mostly from large property owners and energy services firms
Company expects higher utility rates and power shortages to accelerate demand for its products
Tecogen says new retrofit technology for data centers may support margin growth and faster scaling
SERVICES SEGMENT GROWTH - Co said higher services revenue, driven by acquired Aegis maintenance contracts and increased revenues from existing service contracts, contributed to improved results
HIGHER CHILLER REVENUE - Co said increased chiller revenue drove product revenue growth, partially offset by lower cogeneration and engineered accessories revenue
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the electrical components & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Tecogen Inc is $7.50, about 341.2% above its November 11 closing price of $1.70
The stock recently traded at 440 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 456 three months ago
